items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: was the Jimmy Noone that played with you, was he the son of the Chicago Jimmy?

ctx.x: And clarinet. But he and his dad were both put into the Hall of Fame in Oklahoma — the first time they ever had a father and son combination in Oklahoma.
